say:1:1034407001:1.text: Unfortunately, this book can't be viewed by outlanders.
say:1:1034407001:1.source_cn: 很可惜，这本《共舞》并不能给外乡人看。

say:2:1034407002:1.text: All I can say is that the dance it describes will surely please the Deer Spirit.
say:2:1034407002:1.source_cn: 但我可以告诉你，这是一本教人如何跳出取悦鹿灵舞蹈的书。
